notes.note: Bounded source-only review of the shared-style qualification correction and its six-file formatting delta. The pre-push static list now invokes component-style-hygiene; execution coverage names its independently supplied canonical/bad/malformed CLI controls and the existing Biome process tests; the process-heavy manifest classifies the new child-process suite. Motion keepers resolve the public SDK action-control stylesheet and retain the instant-press/fast-release contract, including its exact supported fallbacks. A mounted Button browser assertion is added, not yet executed. Production motion, tokens, component APIs, authority and domain behavior are unchanged. No prose change is needed for these existing policy/owner claims. Managed explicit-path Biome formatted only six files; parsed syntax trees match a44c2d0 after excluding positions/trivia. The five-file focused selection passed36 tests on PRE-FORMAT a44c2d06512e06334c2139dfe1257aa389b378c1 only. Post-format tests/types/browser/mutation/lint-check/readiness/publication remain NOT_RUN; no qualification is borrowed from Root preview or other lanes. This note does not refresh unrelated runtime/provider/native claims.
